decision.detail: I turn from the ballroom door, don't go in, walk the forty steps to the payphone. Drop the coin. Dial. Wait the four rings. She picks up on the fifth, which means she was standing there, which means she's been standing there a while, which means I don't need to make a speech.
decision.intention: One confirmation. Not the van. The van's done. The confirmation is: I am in Pittsburgh. I am not the voice. I am the man who is going to be at your door at eight and lift the goddamn couch with you. I will not make this into a Tuesday. I will not test the shape. I am calling so that when I walk in Wednesday morning, she sees the light on and knows I'm already there. The call is the nail. The sleep is the nail. The door at eight is the nail. Three nails. Hold the thing up.
decision.words: "Hey. I'm in Pittsburgh. Coach got me here at seven. I'll be at your door at eight. Don't get the driver started before then. ...Yeah. ...No, I'm not at the station. I'm at the station. I'm going to sleep on the bench. ...Yeah. ...Okay. I'll be there. I've got the couch. I've got the couch, I've got the van, I've got the eight. That's the whole thing. ...Yeah. Goodnight. I mean—see you Wednesday. ...Yeah. ...Bye."
